one_line: Last great Gond ruler of Garha-Mandla, patron of architecture and music in 17th‑century central India.

appearance.age_look: late 30s to early 40s, lean but sturdy build, about 5'8" in anime proportions
appearance.face: Oval face with a slightly strong jaw, medium-brown central Indian complexion, straight nose, thick arched eyebrows, sharp almond-shaped eyes with a calm but alert gaze, a neatly trimmed moustache that tapers slightly at the ends; default expression is composed and thoughtful, with a hint of quiet resolve.
appearance.hair: Dark black hair, medium length and straight, gathered into a low knot at the back of the head; he wears a deep maroon cloth turban in a Deccan/Mughal style with a modest central sarpech-like ornament in dull gold and a small white feather, plus a narrow maroon cloth band tied around the knot at the nape.
appearance.costume: He wears a long, knee-length angarkha-style robe of fine unpatterned off-white cotton with a wrap-over front tied on the right side by slim fabric ties, the angarkha having a slightly flared skirt and fitted sleeves; over this he wears a sleeveless, hip-length quilted coat (nimq, armor-like, but soft) in muted olive green cotton with simple vertical stitching and no metal plates; a broad deep maroon cotton sash is wrapped around his waist as a kamarband, knotted slightly to his left, with the loose end hanging to mid-thigh; below, he wears narrow churidar-style trousers in plain dull mustard-yellow cotton; his footwear is a pair of brown leather mojari-style shoes with modest, slightly upturned toes; jewellery is restrained but royal—small gold stud earrings, a single medium-thickness gold necklace resting at the collarbone, and a simple signet ring on his right hand; overall textiles are solid-coloured, practical and dignified rather than heavily ornate.
appearance.signature: A single slightly curved talwar with a plain steel blade, a simple brass hilt and disc pommel, worn in a brown leather scabbard with minimal brass fittings and suspended from his maroon waist sash on his left side, plus a small rolled palm-leaf manuscript bundle tucked neatly into the sash on the right as a nod to his musical-literary patronage (its contents never shown).

ref_desc: Hridayshah is a lean, medium-brown man in his late 30s with a low hair knot, maroon Deccan-style turban, off-white angarkha, olive quilted sleeveless coat, maroon sash, mustard churidar, brown mojari shoes, gold accents, a brass-hilt talwar at his left and a small manuscript roll at his right.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of Hridayshah of Garha-Mandla: a lean, medium-brown man in his late 30s with an oval face, strong jaw, neat tapering moustache and sharp almond eyes, his dark black hair gathered into a low knot at the back and wrapped with a deep maroon Deccan-style cloth turban adorned only with a small dull gold central ornament and a short white feather. Show him in an off-white, knee-length angarkha robe with a wrap-over front tied on the right, fitted sleeves and a gentle flare over narrow churidar-style trousers in dull mustard yellow. Over the angarkha he wears a sleeveless, hip-length quilted coat in muted olive green cotton with subtle vertical stitching, evoking soft armor without metal plates. A broad deep maroon cotton sash is wrapped firmly around his waist as a kamarband, knotted slightly to his left with the loose end hanging to mid-thigh, and from this sash on his left side hangs a brown leather-scabbarded talwar with a plain steel blade and simple brass hilt and disc pommel. On the right side of the sash, show a small rolled palm-leaf manuscript bundle tucked securely as a discreet nod to his music and writings. Put simple brown leather mojari shoes with modest upturned toes on his feet, and add restrained royal jewellery: small gold stud earrings, one medium-thickness gold necklace at the collarbone, and a single signet ring on his right hand. Use a restrained palette of off-white, deep maroon, olive green, mustard yellow and brown with dull gold details, and keep his default expression composed and thoughtful, dignified yet ready for action, while clearly showing face, hair, costume and weapons from head to toe.
